name: comments
title: Comments
description: A record's comments, Linear style: thread cards (first comment, Show N more replies, indented replies over hairlines, a flat reply row with the viewer's avatar), a bordered composer with a toolbar row and file drop, day labels, a list with a count, order toggle, Load earlier, skeleton and empty states, edit/delete/copy link/copy text, emoji reactions and an attachments slot.

meta.whenToUse: Discussion on a record's page (a task, a meeting): Linear-style thread cards (first comment, replies, a flat reply row) with the composer at the end (at the top newest first).
meta.whenNotToUse: An activity feed or notifications — use Inbox.
